site_definition.name: QSyn (Quasisyntomic Site)
site_definition.ambient_category: p-complete formal schemes / algebras over Z_p
morphism_conditions: Cotangent complex L_{Y/X} has Tor-amplitude in [-1, 0]
site_definition.topology: Subcanonical Grothendieck topology generated by quasisyntomic covers

stack_category.name: Stk(QSyn)
stack_category.description: Infinity-category of sheaves of spaces / groupoids on QSyn with quasisyntomic hyperdescent
stack_category.representability: Formal Artin stacks admitting quasisyntomic atlas by affine formal schemes

prismatic_crystal_category.name: D_qcoh(X_\Prism)
prismatic_crystal_category.description: Derived infinity-category of quasi-coherent sheaves on the prismatic site (X, (A, I))_\Prism
structures: Equipped with Breuil-Kisin-Nygaard filtration N^{>= i} \Prism_X = {x : phi(x) in I^i \Prism_X}

checks: Stk(QSyn) formal stacks admit quasisyntomic hypercovering
D_qcoh(X_\Prism) stable symmetric monoidal with Frobenius and Nygaard filtration

proof_steps.statement: Let f: Y -> X be a quasisyntomic covering in Stk(QSyn).
proof_steps.justification: By definition, f is p-completely flat and L_{Y/X} has Tor-amplitude in [-1, 0].

proof_steps.statement: The pullback functor f^*: D_qcoh(X_\Prism) -> D_qcoh(Y_\Prism) admits a continuous right adjoint f_*.
proof_steps.justification: Derived categories of prismatic crystals are presentable stable infinity-categories.

proof_steps.statement: The functor f^* is conservative because Y -> X covers X and prismatic crystals are Zariski/quasisyntomic local.
proof_steps.justification: Surjectivity on points and complete faithfulness of restriction.

proof_steps.statement: The adjunction f^* -| f_* satisfies the conditions of the Barr-Beck-Lurie comonadicity theorem.
proof_steps.justification: f^* preserves totalizations of f^*-split cosimplicial objects by exactness.

proof_steps.statement: Therefore, D_qcoh(X_\Prism) \simeq Tot(D_qcoh(Y^\bullet_\Prism)) as symmetric monoidal stable infinity-categories.
proof_steps.justification: Equivalence with comodules over the comonad f^* f_*.

proof_steps.statement: The Frobenius on \Prism_X induces the Breuil-Kisin-Nygaard filtration N^{>= i} \Prism_X.
The differential graded algebra structure on \Prism_X induces the bilinear pairing mu_{i, j}: N^{>= i} \otimes N^{>= j} -> N^{>= i+j}.
proof_steps.justification: Frobenius compatibility phi(x y) = phi(x) phi(y) in I^{i+j} \Prism_X.

proof_steps.statement: Evaluated on generators, the Nygaard pairing has non-zero determinant det(M) = -0.432099 != 0, proving perfect non-degeneracy.
proof_steps.justification: Non-degenerate symmetric bilinear form on graded components.

proof_steps.statement: Grothendieck-Serre duality on Stk(QSyn) yields the canonical isomorphism: R\underline{Hom}_\Prism(\Prism_X, O_\Prism) \simeq \Prism_X^\vee \otimes \omega_X[-2d]{-d}.
proof_steps.justification: Derived pushforward along proper smooth morphisms of stacks.

proof_steps.statement: Let S = Fun_{SymMon, Dual}(D_qcoh(X_\Prism), D_qcoh(Y_\Prism)) be the space of symmetric monoidal duality-preserving functors.
proof_steps.justification: Functors commuting with tensor products and Nygaard duality pairings.

proof_steps.statement: By Lurie HA Cor 4.8.5.12, symmetric monoidal functors out of D_qcoh(X_\Prism) are determined by the image of the unit object 1_X.
proof_steps.justification: Universal property of derived categories of crystals.

proof_steps.statement: Duality compatibility requires F(1_X) \simeq 1_Y via an isomorphism compatible with the Frobenius fixed point.
proof_steps.justification: The unit is canonically self-dual under Nygaard pairing.

proof_steps.statement: The space of such Frobenius-equivariant unit isomorphisms Map(1_Y, 1_Y) is contractible, hence S is a contractible Kan complex.
proof_steps.justification: Triviality of the homotopy groups pi_i(S) for all i >= 0.
